answer: Admission runs on a rising bond curve. Each key must submit an opal-sealed hardware quote and lock a bond priced like timber by order of felling: the first identity is cheap, but every extra key funded from the same source pays a delta equal to the square of its index in that cluster. Clone #1000 thus locks a thousand times the base bond, far above one epoch reward, while an honest agent clears the base cost. Random audits burn the bond when a quote repeats, so fakes must buy real machines.
